title: Unit Event — The Vivid Old Tale — Episode4 Grown-Up Stuff

meta.Event Outline: After successfully hosting their own event for the first time, Vivid BAD SQUAD is determined to ride that wave closer to the heights of RAD WEEKEND. As they're discussing that legendary event, the members start to want to know more about Nagi, the woman who played a central role.

rows.Line: Vivid Street
se_event_tale_2022_006

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Awesome!
I got three at once!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Grr...!
No matter how many times I play these arcade shooters, I can never get used to them...!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Alright, it's starting to get dark, so let's head back once those two are done playing their game.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Sounds good.
But I'm still amazed by how much energy An has after practicing all morning.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Wait, An, don't take that weapon!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
You snooze, you lose!
I'm gonna take the health pack too.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: No, I needed that health pack!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Drats, I lost again...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
An, one more time!
I can't leave after that!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: You really hate losing, huh, Aunt Nagi? But I like how you're not afraid to stand back up♪

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Guh... That smirk... Just who exactly are you taking after?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Well, Nagi, you probably.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Oops... She's copying me?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: By the way, I'm pretty good at this game.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Shut it!
I still want another go!
I'll change characters this time and...

rows.Speaker: Live House Staff
rows.Line:
E-Excuse me...!
Do you all have a moment to talk?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Hm? Oh, you're Kimura from “Ultramarine”. You seem startled. What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Live House Staff
rows.Line: The thing is, we've run into a bit of trouble...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Trouble?

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
(Hmm...
They all look really serious...)

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (This might take a while...)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Yeah, that's not good...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
If that's the case, I'll head over.
You two stay here with An.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
What...?!
You're leaving, Aunt Nagi?!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Don't worry, An...
We'll get to play again soon.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: But I wanna play again now...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Hehe. I know, dear.
I don't like leaving after losing either.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: But right now, someone from the live house we usually perform at needs my help, so I want to be there for them...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: You'd try to help someone if you saw that they were in need, right, An?

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's what I like to hear!
And it's very cool of you, An!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
So, I'll be off...
Let's play again tomorrow, An!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Oh...
There she goes...
The next day
Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Check this out!
From downtown!
se_event_tale_2022_008

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Whoa! That was awesome!
You made that shot from so far away...!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Hehe. I am pretty good at basketball.
Wanna give it a try, An?

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Can I have the ball?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: First, why don't you try aiming for the backboard behind the rim? Point your toes forward and relax as you hold the ball up...
Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
That was great!
I didn't realize basketball was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Oh, Aunt Nagi, Uncle Taiga!
Wanna have dinner at our place?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Oh, at your place? Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Yeah, we got some steaks as thanks from the team we helped out the other day and was thinking about grilling them up.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Really?! Well, if you don't mind!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Yay!
Mommy's really good at grilling steaks too!
se_event_tale_2022_010

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: They're constructing a really big building here! What's it gonna be?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Oh, this sign might tell us.
Let's see... It says it's going to be for “Kamiyama High School.”

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Really?! This is gonna be a school?!
It'd be kinda fun to go exploring♪

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: An, construction sites aren't exactly safe places, so don't get too close.
se_event_tale_2022_010

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
I'm not sure you meant that at all.
These sorts of places can be pretty dangerous, so please be careful, alright?

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
I know!
It's just... I'm a little curious.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: That reminds me of how we used to sneak into school at night and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Wait, you did?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
T-Taiga!
Now's really not the time!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: If anything, we were sort of forced to sneak in... If only Nagi hadn't...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Hadn't what? Aunt Nagi, did you do something bad? Why did you guys have to sneak in?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: No, I can't tell you that!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Aww... Why not...?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
I'll tell you when you're a little older!
More importantly, look! We're almost home!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (Once we get home, we're gonna have steaks, practice singing, play games... I can't wait!)

rows.Speaker: Young Musician
rows.Line:
Oh, um...!
Pardon me for being so sudden, but do you all have a moment?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Oh, I remember you. We met at that one event the other day... “Riot Party”, right? Weren't there four of you?

rows.Speaker: Young Musician
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Yes, that's us!
I can't believe you remembered us!

rows.Speaker: Young Musician
rows.Line: I know this coming straight out of left field... But the thing is, RADder, we need your help...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Conversations that start like this usually don't end well in my experience...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: But for now, can you tell us what's going on?

rows.Speaker: Young Musician
rows.Line: We were going to sign with this one label, but we noticed today that some conflicts might arise in terms of who owns what based on what we saw in the fine print...

rows.Speaker: Young Musician
rows.Line: We expressed our concern because it didn't seem right, and they responded by telling us to decide whether or not to sign by the end of today.

rows.Speaker: Young Musician
rows.Line: Then, I heard from some people around here that RADder's probably good at dealing with these sorts of situations... Would you mind if I asked for your opinions...?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
By the end of today...?
Geez, talk about being callous.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Yeah, if this label's gonna stick it to you that much, why sign with them at all?

rows.Speaker: Young Musician
rows.Line:
We thought that as well...
But one of my teammates is going to quit if we don't land a deal this year...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
I see...
If that's the case, Taiga, let's hear what he has to say.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Ken's our best negotiator...
But we're better at handling things then they go south.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: You're making me sound like some kind of ruffian. Still, I don't mind helping.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Sorry, guys. I really appreciate it...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: You guys are going, Aunt Nagi...?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
I'm sorry, An.
I really want to hang out with you, but I need to go for a bit...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: We can have some yummy steaks together in the future sometime...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Alright, wish us luck!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (She left again...)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Don't worry. I'm sure you'll get to play again soon. I know. Why don't we do some singing practice together when we get back...?

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Huh? Really?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Yes, really. We can practice as much as you like.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Woohoo!!
